runtimes.value: whisper.cpp (Metal, encoder on the Neural Engine via Core ML, 'make large-v3-turbo'); mlx-whisper (mlx-community/whisper-large-v3-turbo, fp16/8-bit/4-bit); mlx-audio (mlx-community/whisper-large-v3-turbo-asr-fp16, with an OpenAI-style /v1/audio/transcriptions server); transformers pipeline on MPS. No blocker found
runtimes.note: whisper.cpp and mlx runtimes use converted files (GGML / mlx-community), not the openai safetensors directly. transformers on MPS not re-checked against a recent issue.

comments.text: Apple's on-device model is 5× faster, though somewhat less accurate ([llimllib, 13.10.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50071395)).
Voxtral and Qwen3-ASR preferred for multilingual work ([decide1000, 28.08.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49478139); [skolos, 08.10.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50013705)).

Preferred to Parakeet for dictation on an M3 Max ([obmelvin, 13.07.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48897089)); copes better with accents and jargon ([AG342, 15.06.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48536021)).
